title: Guaranteed throughput bands + elastic reservations: pricing experiment & Enterprise SQ playbook
creator: Marisol Chen
description: Background: Sales and Customer Success report that customers want predictable tail latency and cost controls for Dedicated deployments without committing to large fixed GPU reservations. Objective: design an experiment that tests a hybrid pricing model composed of guaranteed-throughput bands (capacity tiers with performance SLOs) + an elastic reservations overlay (short-term autoscale credits that preserve pricing predictability). Also prepare a templated Enterprise Security Questionnaire (SQ) response bundle tied to each band so sales can rapidly respond to RFPs. Success metrics: conversion lift on RFQ -> contract signed by 15%, reduced negotiation time by 30% (measured in days), and <10% increase in average unit cost for Redwood across pilot customers. Out of scope: on-prem single-tenant appliance pricing; that will be in a follow-up.
